scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.import:cms-2026-rates: pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run import:cms-2026-rates
scripts.restore:cms-2026-rate-book-benchmarks: pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run restore:cms-2026-rate-book-benchmarks
scripts.import:cms-2026-plan-costs: pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run import:cms-2026-plan-costs
scripts.import:cms-2026-look-alikes: pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run import:cms-2026-look-alikes
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
